rows.title: About Us | MIT OpenCourseWare | Free Online Course Materials
headings: Since 2001, MIT OpenCourseWare (OCW) has created new opportunities for learners and educators around the world. We’re sharing Open Educational Resources (OER) from MIT and helping to lead and sustain a global revolution in free access to knowledge.

Now in our 25th year, this vital mission has never been more important. MIT OpenCourseWare will continue to share the latest teaching and insights from MIT faculty, and collaborate across the dynamic open knowledge ecosystem to build a world of more vibrant, equitable and inclusive education for all.
We’re growing this open education legacy with
, the singular hub for all lifelong learning at MIT, which unifies MIT OpenCourseWare, MITx, and many other learning opportunities with AI-enabled guidance and personalizations.
